field.name: editedDate
field.description: When its author last changed the text of a note or comment after posting it (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.update#RecordNote, mantle.request.RequestServices.update#RequestComment); empty for one never changed. A timeline shows it as edited.

field.name: snoozedThruDate
field.description: Hidden from the Inbox until this date

entity.description: A label one party put on one internal message (CommunicationEvent). The label is an EmailLabel of that party's Internal email account, so two people on the same message label it apart. A thread shows a label when any of its messages has it for that party. Internal messages have no folders.

The line of a merge request's diff a review comment is on (MR Moqui, no Java counterpart): the comment is a CommunicationEvent of type Comment filed on the merge request (CommunicationEventRecord with recordEntityName moqui.resource.GitMergeRequest), its replies children of it (parentCommEventId, rootCommEventId); the first comment of a thread holds the anchor and its status CeResolved when the thread is resolved (mantle.work.GitServices.store#ReviewAnchor, resolve#ReviewThread). commitId is the source head the line was read at; outdated is Y once a later head changed the line (refresh#ReviewAnchors).

field.name: oldLine
field.description: The line in the target side; empty for an added line

field.name: newLine
field.description: The line in the source side; empty for a deleted line

field.name: lineText
field.description: The line as it was, for an outdated thread

entity.description: A communication event filed on any record, by the record's full entity name and the value of its single primary key field, for a record type without a join of its own. The own joins (OrderCommunicationEvent, RequestCommEvent, WorkEffortCommEvent, WikiPageCommunicationEvent) stay, and a party's link is the event's from and to party and its CommunicationEventParty rows; mantle.party.CommunicationServices.link#CommunicationEventRecord chooses.

field.name: recordUrl
field.description: The record's screen, for the follower notification's link

field.name: accessScreenLocation
field.description: The screens the user chose the record from, comma-separated: its followers' access is checked under them when the message is filed, after the send, with no screen of its own (notify#RecordFollowers, SH-UI-009)

entity.description: A user following a record (its full entity name and single primary key value), and which kinds of activity on it notify the user: messages, notes, activities and changes. Unfollowing deletes the row.

A record type whose note and message notices (CommunicationServices notify#RecordMention, notify#RecordFollowers) go to the users they are sent to alone (directOnly: a subscription to every message of ChatterMention or RecordFollow, set in Tools, receives none), since they name the record and quote the note. Seeded by the owner's component beside its entity (IronStone People's employment, application and qualification; the user's call of Nov 12, 2026, People follow-up 1); a confidential case, which is a Request of its own kind, hands its notices to PeopleCaseUpdate instead. disabled Y leaves it out.

field.name: ownerText
field.description: Whose record type it is, for a reader

entity.description: A record type the record link services take (CommunicationServices get#RecordLinkInfo; SEC-BOS-87): the record panels, cards, notes, messages, activities, record rooms and record folders of a record of any other entity are refused. Registered by the component that hosts the record, as data: Mantle the types its joins and rules cover; an app the records its screens show (mr-boss data/BossSetupRecordTypesData.xml). Beside get#RecordLinkInfo's own rules for its types and the user's entity filters, a registration names how a record of it is seen, the first that is set: visibleService, a service implementing mantle.party.CommunicationServices.check#RecordTypeVisible (recordEntityName, recordId; answers recordVisible), called with authorization disabled, which applies the host app's own rule; parentEntityName with parentField, the record seen as the record its field names is (another registered type; with that field empty, by organizationField when it is set too, else a system administrator's); organizationField, the field holding the record's organization, which must be one of the user's (every one for a system administrator; a record with none is a system administrator's). These apply with authorization on, as get#RecordLinkInfo's rules for a user do. A registration with none of these is seen by a system administrator alone (and logged as an error when loaded), unless it says why it needs none: codeRule Y, which holds only for a type get#RecordLinkInfo rules itself (Mantle's own rows, the fixed list of RecordLinkTypes.js codeRuled; another row claiming it is logged and refused), or publicRead Y, public content seen by any user under the entity filters alone (no row uses it now). disabled Y leaves it out.

field.name: ownerText
field.description: Whose record type it is, for a reader

field.name: codeRule
field.description: Y: get#RecordLinkInfo's own rules and the entity filters decide (Mantle's registrations)

field.name: publicRead
field.description: Y: public content, seen by any user under the entity filters alone
